h1: Powering UK Enterprise with Autonomous Cloud Agents
sub: Deploy dedicated AI agents with isolated cloud computers that browse, write code, and coordinate tasks 24/7, keeping your British business moving even when you step away.
audience: London fintech teams, Edinburgh asset managers, Manchester creative agencies, Oxford life-science founders, and independent UK consultants.
manifesto: In a fast-paced British economy spanning the City of London to Manchester's digital hubs, Ceyo gives professionals tireless autonomous agents that handle deep research, continuous coding, and administrative routine without ever sleeping.

uses.d: Your agent autonomously navigates registry portals, downloads filings, extracts director histories, and drafts structured compliance dossiers.
Set a browser agent to track real estate price reductions across London and the Home Counties, updating Google Sheets every morning.
Compile overnight market movements across European and US exchanges into structured briefings delivered straight to your Telegram before breakfast.
Let your coding agent build, test, and host client landing pages or internal dashboards on its dedicated cloud computer while you sleep.
Connect Slack, Notion, and Gmail into a coordinated bot team that triages inbound client enquiries and schedules calendar follow-ups.
Deploy phone-call agents to qualify inbound contractor enquiries, handle appointment reschedules, and sync transcripts directly to your CRM.

steps.d: Select your agent's core skills, configure integrations across 1,000+ tools, and launch its isolated cloud computer in seconds.
Assign tasks on Telegram group chats, conduct voice review calls, or set scheduled daily research runs.
Your bots continue browsing the web, executing code, and updating databases even after you close your laptop.

chapters.d: While you travel on the Jubilee line, your Telegram bot delivers a curated digest of regulatory notices and FTSE movements. Key action items are already highlighted and cross-referenced against your calendar.

Your browser agent navigates competitor pricing portals, fills enquiry forms, and extracts comparative data. It synthesises the findings into a shared Notion document without interrupting your client meetings.

Two specialist bots collaborate in a shared Telegram chat: one writes Python scrapers in its cloud terminal while the second tests execution and catches errors. You review and approve the clean pull request in one tap.

You power down for the night, but your agents keep running scheduled tasks on their cloud machines. They clean CRM records, monitor overseas filings, and organise files for tomorrow's London working day.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens daily; a card is linked upon registration and is only charged when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does Ceyo work natively with Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo lets you deploy personal Telegram bots and create team group chats where multiple specialist bots collaborate together on research, code, and routine updates.

faq.q: What happens when my computer or phone is switched off?
faq.a: Every bot operates inside its own isolated cloud environment that functions independently around the clock. Your workflows, scrapers, and scheduled tasks proceed uninterrupted 24/7.

faq.q: What languages and international markets are supported?
faq.a: Ceyo supports English and major global languages, allowing your agents to translate source documentation, browse multilingual websites, and compose international reports effortlessly.

faq.q: How do Ceyo agents interact with external web pages?
faq.a: Each agent uses an autonomous cloud browser capable of opening URLs, navigating dynamic pages, filling out online forms, and extracting live pricing or research data securely.
